leavePay.title: Leave pay
leavePay.subtitle: How payroll pays approved sick, parental and unpaid leave in each country.
leavePay.howBody: Each working day (Monday to Friday) of approved leave is paid at the rule's rate, as a share of the salary for the period's working days, so a whole month away unpaid takes off the whole salary. Pay bands count from the first day of the absence, also when it began in an earlier pay period, and a leave request that starts on the next working day continues the same absence. Where your payroll template declares statutory pay for a leave type (sick pay in Germany, the Netherlands, Estonia and Albania; unpaid parental leave in Estonia and Ireland), it applies until you add your own rule; other leave without a rule is paid in full, and the payroll run lists it as something to check before approving. Public holidays count as working days, and statutory payments made by an insurer or the state (such as UK Statutory Sick Pay) are not added. Some statutory templates can't yet calculate sick or maternity pay, or a period with reduced pay, and will list the employee as an issue; see
leavePay.emptyBody: Approved leave is paid in full, or as your payroll template's statutory rule says where it has one, until you add a rule, for example for unpaid leave, or sick pay that ends after six weeks.
leavePay.deleteBody: Leave of this type then follows your payroll template's statutory rule where it has one, and is otherwise paid in full. Runs already calculated keep their amounts until they are recalculated.

form.duplicate: There is already a rule for this leave type in this country; edit that one instead.
form.bandsHint: Optional. Days count in calendar days from the first day of the absence: for German sick pay, days 1 to 42 at 100%, then unpaid.
form.overlap: This band starts before the previous one ends.
form.bandInvalid: Use whole days from day 1, an end day on or after the start, and a percentage from 0 to 100.
form.everyDayPaid: Paid on each day of leave
form.otherwiseHint: Share of the daily salary paid; 0% is unpaid.
form.otherwiseUnused: Not used: the last band runs to the end of the absence.
form.preTaxOn: The pay not paid also lowers taxable pay and contribution bases, as for pay not earned.
form.preTaxOff: Taken from net pay: tax and contributions are still charged on the full salary.
form.recalculate: Applies to runs calculated from now on; recalculate a draft or calculated run to update it.
form.overrideHint: Starts from the statutory rule of {{ name }}; your rule replaces it for this country and leave type.

leavePay.overridesTemplate: Replaces the payroll template's statutory rule
